notes: Account snapshot: GroundWave HelpWorks — contact-center platform for SMBs scaling into mid-market. Heavy focus on agent-assist and automated ticket triage. Wants ribboned RAG approach: citations, freshness guarantees, and multi-source ranking.

Key pain: knowledge sources spread across Zendesk, Confluence, S3 archival buckets, internal MySQL (support DB), and customer Git repos. Current retrieval returns stale KB pages and lacks provenance/citation links.

Performance targets: 95th pctile latency for agent-assist < 350ms for short prompts; sustain 250 concurrent active agents with bursts to ~1.2k during product launches. Cost sensitivity but prioritizes reliability during spikes.

Model & routing: preference for open LLMs with ability to route to smaller quantized variants for cost/latency tradeoffs. Needs automatic fallback policy (eg: gen -> rerank -> snippet-only response) when heavy load.
Integration requirements: tool-calling to create JIRA tickets, update CRM contacts, and kick off escalations from agent UI. Requires webhook auth pattern and idempotency guarantees.

Security/compliance: EU data residency for some tenant data, SSO/SAML, full audit logs, KMS support for envelope encryption, and retention policy controls. IDS/EDR and Splunk SIEM integration requested.

- 2025-11-10: Discovery call (ff-20251110-68a). Initial product fit: agent assist + summarization. AE Maya + SE Jordan present.

- 2026-02-28: POC results (ff-20260228-poc-results). Passed recall target (precision@5 0.78) and citation accuracy, but observed latency spikes during burst replay—root cause: retrieval fanout + cold KV cache.
